cards.label: Bermondsey — the storage unit
cards.text: James opens the door in what you're coming to recognise as his default expression: mild disappointment that the world continues to contain other people.

cards.speaker: You
cards.text: "If you've got more orders than you can handle, I could take the overflow. The basic stuff that takes your time without needing your skill."
James looks at you for a long moment. He picks up a glass sphere from his bench, turns it over, sets it down again. This appears to be how he thinks.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "You are proposing to be my assistant."

cards.speaker: You
cards.text: "If that's how you want to frame it."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "I want to frame it accurately. You would not be a partner, a student, or a colleague. You would handle simple orders. I would retain all complex work. You would not advertise yourself as my associate."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Hm. Then there's a problem. I've seen your pearls. Archie sells them. They're mediocre." He lets that sit. "The same recipe can be made better. The trade calls it rank. You make rank two: the procedure, followed. Rank three needs something the procedure leaves out."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "One thing, then, and you can work out what it means. You let go of the press too early."

cards.speaker: You
cards.text: "You compress it longer. I'd worked that out."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Had you." He doesn't make it a question. "Knowing a thing and doing it are separate skills, and most people stop at the first. I don't hand out overflow on anyone's say-so. Including yours."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: He clears a space on the bench and sets down a jar of his own calc. "Rank three. My calc, so you can stop counting it. You don't leave until it's done."

choices.label: Take the press

lines.hintExact: James: "Eighty-two on the gauge. Short of the red line, not on it."
lines.talkThrough: James: "Stop. Watch my hands. Every number, once. I'm not doing this twice."

choices.result_text: The pearl comes off the heat with a different weight to it. James takes it from you before you can look at it properly.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: He turns it under the lamp. "Rank three." A pause, long enough to count as approval. "Adequate."

cards.speaker: You
cards.text: "What about the other recipes? Archie says you know about forty."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Archie says a great deal. I work time and life calc. Those recipes I'll sell you, at a price that reflects the indignity of teaching. The rest belong to the Guild. I'll write to someone there. They answer letters at their own pace."

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: "Practise. Get good enough and I may have a use for you beyond pearls." His thumb finds the brass case at his wrist, the way some people check a watch they don't need. He doesn't explain. "I'll send you overflow. Don't expect it to be glamorous. And don't be late."
You leave with one decent pearl and the firm sense that James considers this arrangement a concession rather than a collaboration. You suspect that won't change.
